parameters: \bThe volcano's eruption is proof that\nthe earth is alive.

\bFrom out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!
\bI must refine the art of concealment.\nI bid thee farewell.

\bThe volcanic ash blocks the sun,\nso it doesn't get very warm.
